Read-only research task in the repo /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa. Do NOT modify anything.

CRITICAL CONTEXT: this repo's working tree, as currently checked out, is on branch `feature/storefront-preview-contentful` (the PR #43 branch), NOT `main`. Verify this first with `git branch --show-current` and `git status`. Do ALL your file reads against the actual working-tree files on disk (plain `cat`/`Read`, not `git show main:...`) — a previous pass in this same investigation made the mistake of checking against `main` instead of the real working tree and got some facts wrong as a result. Also check `git log --all --oneline` and `gh pr list --state all` (via Bash) for anything that has changed or been added SINCE 2026-08-01, since some time has passed in this engagement.

BACKGROUND: There's a disputed TSD rule (Confluence 346783750, section 5.5) that splits Contentful-consuming components into "Studio Experience" (drag-and-drop Contentful Experience Builder, registered via defineComponents in overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/, currently used for Z.immerse/campaign pages) versus "coded content-type component" (hand-built React components in overrides/app/components/contentful/, for fixed slots like homepage/footer/nav/PLP/PDP). A Solution Architect (Tim Lavelle) has pushed back saying most components will end up used in the Experience Builder anyway, undermining the two-path split. A prior investigation found ONE relevant clue: `.docs/temp/humanContentfulGuide.md` (on a DIFFERENT branch, `feature/contentfulDoc`, added by PR #38, which was OPEN/unmerged at the time) states the homepage is "planned to be an Experience" but says the announcement banner is a "regular content entry" (not Experience) — this partially conflicts with a Jira finding (SFCC-51) which says the banner IS Studio-placed.

TASK: re-verify and refresh this investigation right now:
1. Confirm current branch state as above.
2. Check whether PR #38 has since merged, closed, or changed (gh pr view 38). Check whether `.docs/temp/humanContentfulGuide.md` now exists on the CURRENT working-tree branch (`feature/storefront-preview-contentful`) — has it been merged in since we last checked? If it's still only on `feature/contentfulDoc`, confirm that branch still exists and check for any new commits to it since 2026-07-17.
3. Re-check the `overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/` directory: is it still exactly 3 registered components (collectionHero, imageText, shoppableImage) via definitions.ts, or has anything been added/changed?
4. Re-check the 4 coded components (heroBanner, duplexSection, productHero, videoEmbed) for any new commits since 2026-07-22 (their last known touch).
5. `gh pr list --state all` and `git log --all --oneline` — anything new since 2026-08-01 that mentions "experience", "component library", "flexible", "studio", or component-architecture strategy?
6. Re-check PR #43's current state (still open? merged?) since it's the branch we're on.

Report back with explicit VERIFIED/CHANGED/NEW/NO-CHANGE verdicts per item, citing file paths, commit hashes, or PR numbers. Do not speculate, only report what you directly find.
